title: Thomas Z NDE 9382
content: I had gotten a piece of metal in my eye when I was working on my car. I had rinsed out my eye. Then I had my wife look for anything in my eye and she did not see anything. I was working outside security, driving around in a car on the night shift at the prison. I had to go inside the prison to eat my dinner and while I was there I stopped by the medical department and had a nurse look at my eye. She didn't see anything in it either. Yet, I still had problems with it. When I left work, I went to the nearest emergency room and the nurse there took a look a my eye and told me I had a piece of metal in it. A doctor came to see me. He put my head into a medical device so I could not move my head. He took the metal out and also had to grind out some rust. After he did that, he put me into a large chair and told me to keep my head up. I passed out and instantly was in outer space. I could hear a swooshing noise and I could see a lot of stars and the blackness of space. There was also a bright, green line stretching from as far as I could see to my left and to my right. While wondering which way to go, I was slowly drifting to the left so I went to the left. It didn't take me very long and I was in front of a tunnel. The green line covered the tunnel with what appeared to be a door. The yellowish light from the tunnel was seeping out from behind the green door. The doctor yelled at me to keep my head up and instantly, I was back in my body. Looking back at this I remember not seeing my nose or any other part of my body. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 2006 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness If felt the same. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? As soon as I passed out I was very alert. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Outer space was very clear and bright. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing was the same, I heard swooshing sound. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw a bright green line and a yellowish light from the tunnel. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place I was in outer space where it was very black with bright white stars. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was in awe of what was happening. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I felt just I was in my body but I had no body. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? No changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I was telling people right after I came home and people just looked at me as if I was crazy. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I have seen information about NDE on tv. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I felt the same when I was out of my body as in my body. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I felt alive being out of my body. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Instantly was in outer space; reported not seeing his nose or any other part of his body.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Could hear a 'swooshing noise' and was 'slowly drifting to the left'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Outer space: blackness with many stars; a bright green line stretching left and right; a tunnel with a green 'door' and yellowish light seeping out.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out after metal removal and rust grinding from eye in emergency room; not considered life-threatening.

person_demographics.occupation: Outside security at a prison (night shift, driving around in a car).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Outer space setting with a bright green line; tunnel appeared covered by a green 'door' with yellowish light seeping out; return triggered by doctor yelling to keep head up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Passed out → found himself in outer space → drifted left → arrived in front of a tunnel/green door with yellowish light → instantly returned when doctor yelled.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Outer space setting with a bright green line stretching left and right; tunnel covered by a green line forming what appeared to be a door.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I passed out and instantly was in outer space.” “There was also a bright, green line stretching from as far as I could see to my left and to my right.” “The yellowish light from the tunnel was seeping out from behind the green door.” “I remember not seeing my nose or any other part of my body.”
